idea: A coherent two-day directional move may persist beyond trading costs.
entry_rule: H1 at 00/06/12/18 UTC: 48-return log drift / sqrt(sum squared returns) >= 1.5 in magnitude; efficiency >= .25; enter next H1 open.
stop_rule: 2 prior H1 ATR(24) from executable entry.
limitations: Intraday hypothesis inspired by momentum, not a replication of monthly futures literature.
risk_model: one planned-risk unit; one open position per strategy/instrument; no compounding

idea: Extreme deviation from the rolling median may revert when its first reversal starts.
entry_rule: Previous H1 close >2.5 scaled MAD(48) from prior median; current H1 moves toward median; same signed deviation; enter next open.
target_rule: Frozen median of 48 closes before trigger; >=1R executable reward.
limitations: Median is not intrinsic value; persistent trends can defeat reversion.
risk_model: one planned-risk unit; one open position per strategy/instrument; no compounding

idea: A first range escape after narrow trading may persist.
entry_rule: Prior 12 H1 high-low range <=2.5 prior ATR(24); first close beyond it by .1 ATR; enter next open.
limitations: Few compressions may meet fixed rule; no thresholds retuned to increase count.
risk_model: one planned-risk unit; one open position per strategy/instrument; no compounding

idea: A large directional shock followed by a reversal may reflect temporary dislocation.
entry_rule: Prior H1 range >2.5 prior ATR(24), body >=70% range; current close crosses shock midpoint in opposite direction; enter next open.
stop_rule: Beyond shock extreme by .2 prior ATR(24).
limitations: No news feed; shocks can be permanent information, not temporary liquidity.
risk_model: one planned-risk unit; one open position per strategy/instrument; no compounding

idea: BTC/ETH relative return shocks may mean-revert conditionally.
entry_rule: BTC/ETH only: rolling prior 48 H1 returns OLS beta; current residual >2.5 prior residual SD; fade residual next H1 open.
limitations: Unhedged single-leg residual signal; not market-neutral arbitrage. Both CFDs share crypto risk.
risk_model: one planned-risk unit; one open position per strategy/instrument; no compounding
